label: Mk1 rig battery
note: Doc 20 section 4.1's charge, as data: one cu is four watt-hours, and a full battery is 100,000 cu. The bay's umbilical puts back 50,000 cu an IC hour, so a 600 IC s unload regains 8,300 cu. Driving draws 15 cu per cell of nominal locomotion cost 100, so a regolith cell (150) is 22.5 cu and a kilometre of regolith 2,250 cu. The reserve rule is 5 %: no act may leave less than 5,000 cu after the trip home. It has no radius; every radius a tool names is per axis, a square.
